(def invoices (retry {:delays [200ms 500ms] :on [Unavailable RateLimited]} (call payments.invoices {})))
(defn is-open? [inv] (= (get inv :status) "open"))
(def open-invoices (filter is-open? invoices))
(defn ensure-charged [inv]
  (loop {:max 20} [t 0]
    (let [existing (retry {:delays [200ms 500ms 1s] :on [Unavailable RateLimited Timeout]} (call payments.charges {:invoice (get inv :id)}))]
      (if (not= (count existing) 0)
        (get inv :id)
        (match (attempt (call payments.charge {:invoice (get inv :id) :amount_cents (get inv :amount_cents)}))
          (ok r) (get inv :id)
          (err e) (match (get e :kind)
                    Unavailable (recur (+ t 1))
                    Timeout (recur (+ t 1))
                    RateLimited (recur (+ t 1))
                    _ (first [])))))))
(def charged-ids (map ensure-charged open-invoices))
charged-ids
